expected_description: A Cluster is reported when no ScheduledBackup in its own namespace names it in spec.cluster.name.
key_elements: target Cluster; dependency ScheduledBackup; match on name AND same namespace; reported when none matches

expected_description: A Pooler is reported when a Cluster with the same name exists in the same namespace.
key_elements: target Pooler; dependency Cluster; same name AND same namespace; reported when one matches (presence, not absence)

expected_description: An ApplicationSet is reported when it owns no Application.
key_elements: target ApplicationSet; dependency Application; ownership via ownerReferences; reported when none is owned

expected_description: A ClusterIssuer is reported when no Certificate and no CertificateRequest names it with kind ClusterIssuer.
key_elements: target ClusterIssuer; dependencies Certificate AND CertificateRequest; name match; kind must be ClusterIssuer; reported when none matches

expected_description: A Function is reported when no Composition, Operation, CronOperation or WatchOperation invokes it in any step of its pipeline.
key_elements: target Function; the four pipeline kinds; any pipeline step; reported when none matches
